info.title: RMS+ POS Agent API
info.description: Destination-owned foundation contract for the per-device Windows POS Agent. The Agent exposes a fixed HTTPS loopback endpoint for direct Support Hub browser access. Windows Negotiate supplies the authenticated identity, local Built-in Administrators membership authorizes protected reads and future mutations, and no Support Hub backend relay is involved. INT-07 exposes only read-only device, redacted configuration, and Windows service visibility endpoints. Mutation tokens are short-lived, one-use, and server-operation-bound for future state-changing operations.

get.description: Confirms that the local Agent process is alive and able to answer HTTP requests. Authentication and authorization are anonymous/none. The check has no side effects and a successful 200 response does not prove POS SQL connectivity, SCM connectivity, SMB connectivity, backup readiness, restore readiness, browser authentication, or mutation authorization.

200.description: The Agent process is alive and returned a HealthStatusDto.

400.description: The Agent rejected a non-canonical host with host_rejected or a non-HTTPS request with https_required; the response uses the safe Agent problem-details contract.

example.title: The request host is not accepted.

get.description: Returns the foundation-stage readiness response. Authentication and authorization are anonymous/none, and the check has no side effects. At this stage readiness uses the same implementation behavior as liveness and does not probe POS SQL, SCM, SMB, backup, restore, or feature dependencies.

200.description: The Agent returned its current HealthStatusDto readiness state.

400.description: The Agent rejected a non-canonical host with host_rejected or a non-HTTPS request with https_required; the response uses the safe Agent problem-details contract.

example.title: The request host is not accepted.

get.description: Returns security and API-version diagnostics for the Windows account authenticated by Negotiate. Any authenticated Windows account with a resolvable Windows SID may call this endpoint. IsAuthorized represents membership in the local machine's Built-in Administrators group as resolved by Windows account membership, independently of UAC browser-token elevation. The raw Windows SID is not returned to the browser. The endpoint has no side effects.

200.description: The authenticated account's SessionInfoDto diagnostics and API-version metadata.

400.description: The Agent rejected a non-canonical host with host_rejected or a non-HTTPS request with https_required; the response uses the safe Agent problem-details contract.

example.title: The request host is not accepted.

401.description: The Windows authentication middleware issued a Negotiate challenge. This framework response is not guaranteed to contain an AgentProblemDetailsDto body; clients should inspect the WWW-Authenticate header.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Negotiate challenge emitted by the Windows authentication middleware.

403.description: The authenticated identity reached the endpoint, but its Windows SID could not be resolved. The Agent returns application/problem+json with code windows_sid_unavailable. The exact-origin transport gate may also reject a browser origin with code origin_rejected.

example.title: The authenticated Windows SID could not be resolved.

post.summary: Issue a one-use mutation authorization token
post.description: Issues a short-lived, one-use token for one server-registered mutation operation. Windows Negotiate authentication and local Built-in Administrators membership are required; normal browser elevation is not. The request supplies only a logical operationId. The server registry resolves the target operation and HTTP method. The result is bound to the authenticated Windows SID, exact Support Hub Origin, target operation, and server-resolved method, with replay and expiry enforcement. The token is header-only, memory-only, and does not itself perform the POS mutation. Production registers no feature mutation during this foundation gate, so unknown operations return operation_not_supported without issuing a token.

requestBody.description: The browser supplies only the server-known logical operationId. It does not supply a target path or HTTP method; the Agent's operation registry owns those semantics.

200.description: The Agent issued a short-lived one-use token for the registered operation.

400.description: The Agent rejected an unregistered operationId with application/problem+json code operation_not_supported; no mutation token is issued. The host and HTTPS middleware may also return host_rejected or https_required in this transport response.

example.title: The requested mutation operation is not supported.

401.description: The Windows authentication middleware issued a Negotiate challenge. This framework response is not guaranteed to contain an AgentProblemDetailsDto body; clients should inspect the WWW-Authenticate header.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Negotiate challenge emitted by the Windows authentication middleware.

403.description: AuthorizationMiddleware may reject a non-Administrator before the endpoint executes; that policy-forbid response is bodyless and is not guaranteed to be AgentProblemDetails. If the endpoint executes and cannot resolve the authenticated Windows SID, it returns application/problem+json with code windows_sid_unavailable. The exact-origin transport gate may reject an untrusted browser origin with code origin_rejected.

429.description: The bounded in-memory mutation-token retention limit has been reached; the Agent returns application/problem+json with code mutation_token_capacity and issues no token.

example.title: The mutation-token retention limit has been reached.

get.description: Returns the service-owned POS configuration read model for the local device. Password values are represented only by secret-presence flags; SQL/RDB passwords, protected data, backup paths, configuration source paths, and unrestricted host paths are never returned. This GET does not perform configuration mutation.

200.description: The Agent returned the redacted configuration read model without secret values.

400.description: The Agent rejected a non-canonical host with host_rejected or a non-HTTPS request with https_required; the response uses the safe Agent problem-details contract.

example.title: The request host is not accepted.

403.description: AuthorizationMiddleware may reject a non-Administrator with a bodyless response. If the exact-origin transport gate rejects the browser origin, the safe problem code is origin_rejected.

500.description: The Agent failed while reading a server-owned dependency and returned a safe generic server-error response without exception details.

get.description: Returns current status evidence for the server-owned, allow-listed Windows services configured on the local Agent. Service identifiers are opaque and the response contains visibility/status only. No start, stop, restart, delete, command, or process control is registered in this first release; allowedActions is always empty.

200.description: The Agent returned allow-listed service status summaries with no mutation actions.

mainServer.detail: Main-server TCP endpoint is reachable; application health was not queried.

type.description: Problem type identifier for the stable Agent error contract.

title.description: Safe human-readable explanation of why the Agent rejected the request.

status.description: HTTP status code returned by the Agent.

code.description: Optional stable machine-readable Agent problem code used by clients; it never carries raw identity or credential data.

correlationId.description: Optional request correlation identifier echoed by the Agent for diagnostics.

AgentProblemDetailsDto.description: Safe application/problem+json error contract. Code is a stable problem code and correlationId may identify the request; sensitive identity and machine details are not included.

displayName.description: User-facing browse-root label; it is not a host path.

BrowseRootDto.description: Safe browse-root display metadata. The corresponding host path remains server-owned.

agentVersion.description: Installed Agent assembly version produced by the Agent.

operatingSystem.description: Operating-system label produced by the Agent.

browseRoots.description: Safe browse-root display metadata. INT-07 publishes no file-browse capability.

DeviceCapabilitiesDto.description: Non-secret capability metadata for the installed Agent. Browse roots expose display metadata only and do not expose host paths.

localSql.description: Independent local SQL endpoint reachability evidence.

DeviceConnectivityDto.description: Independent local SQL and main-server reachability evidence. Reachable TCP does not claim that SQL or application health was queried.

branchCode.description: Server-owned branch code for the local POS device.

posNumber.description: Server-owned POS number for the local device.

release.description: Configured RMS+ release label for the local device.

clientName.description: Configured client/product label for the local device.

DeviceIdentityDto.description: Safe server-owned branch, POS, release, and client identity. It contains no Windows SID, credential, or unrestricted host path.

freshness.description: Freshness classification for this observation; it is never collapsed into a bare online boolean.

lastCheckedUtc.description: UTC time at which this observation was last checked, when available.

detail.description: Safe diagnostic detail without credentials, Windows SIDs, or raw exception text.

EvidenceDto.description: Freshness and check-time evidence for the service state.

FreshnessState.description: Freshness classification for this observation; it is never collapsed into a bare online boolean.

status.description: Identifies which anonymous foundation health check produced the response (live or ready).

HealthStatusDto.description: Anonymous health response produced by the Agent. Status identifies the foundation check that answered; it contains no machine or credential detail.

operationId.description: Stable logical identifier for a server-registered operation. The browser supplies this identifier only; it cannot choose the target path or HTTP method.

MutationTokenIssueRequestDto.description: Browser request for a token for one logical operation known to the server. The browser cannot supply the target HTTP method or path.

token.description: Opaque short-lived, one-use token produced by the Agent. It is bound to the authenticated Windows SID, exact Origin, operation, and server-resolved method and should remain in browser memory.

expiresAtUtc.description: UTC expiry instant enforced by the Agent for the one-use mutation token.

MutationTokenIssueResponseDto.description: Opaque, short-lived mutation-token response produced by the Agent. The token is intended for browser memory only.

sqlInstance.description: Configured SQL endpoint label. It is not a credential and does not expose a password.

sqlUser.description: Configured SQL user name; the corresponding password is never returned.

hasSqlPassword.description: Whether the Agent has a stored SQL password, without returning the password value.

branchCode.description: Configured branch code for the local POS device.

posNumber.description: Configured POS number for the local device.

release.description: Configured RMS+ release label for the local device.

clientName.description: Configured client/product label for the local device.

apiBaseUrl.description: Configured main API base URL used by the Agent's server-side connectivity check.

databases.description: Configured database labels; connection credentials are not included.

services.description: Configured Windows service names used internally by the Agent; no control operation is implied.

downloader.description: Redacted DB Downloader settings with secret-presence metadata only.

version.description: Service-owned optimistic-concurrency version for future configuration mutations.

RedactedConfigurationDto.description: Service-owned POS configuration with secret-presence flags. Password values, protected data, backup paths, and configuration source paths are never returned.

rdbServerIp.description: Configured RDB server address; no RDB password is returned.

rdbUsername.description: Configured RDB user name; the corresponding password is never returned.

hasRdbPassword.description: Whether the Agent has a stored RDB password, without returning the password value.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Configured downloader polling interval in seconds.

timeoutSeconds.description: Configured downloader operation timeout in seconds.

RedactedDownloaderConfigurationDto.description: Redacted DB Downloader settings with secret-presence metadata only.

ServiceRuntimeState.description: Current Windows service runtime state observed by the Agent.

serviceId.description: Opaque server-issued service identifier; the raw Windows service name is not accepted from a browser.

displayName.description: Safe display name for the allow-listed Windows service.

state.description: Current Windows service runtime state observed by the Agent.

lastChecked.description: Freshness and check-time evidence for the service state.

allowedActions.description: Mutation actions exposed by this Agent. INT-07 always returns an empty array.

lastOutcome.description: Safe prior-operation outcome, when present; INT-07 performs no service operation.

ServiceSummaryDto.description: Allow-listed Windows service visibility and status evidence. This first release exposes no service control actions.

principalName.description: The OS-provided display name of the authenticated Windows principal. It is produced by Negotiate and is not browser-supplied.

isAuthorized.description: Whether the authenticated account is a member of the local Built-in Administrators group. This is account membership resolved by Windows and is independent of UAC token elevation; the browser cannot supply it.

agentVersion.description: The installed Agent assembly version produced by the Agent.

apiVersion.description: The Agent contract version produced by the Agent.

supportedApiVersions.description: Contract versions the installed Agent can serve, produced by the Agent rather than accepted from the browser.

SessionInfoDto.description: Security and API-version diagnostics produced by the Agent for the authenticated Windows account. The raw Windows SID is intentionally omitted.

WindowsNegotiate.description: Windows Integrated Authentication using Negotiate. The browser/OS supplies credentials with a credentialed cross-origin request; clients must rely on the browser's integrated credential flow.
